verdict.rationale: BILL provides an official v3 API and developer docs covering AP/AR/S&E, webhooks, sandbox environment, and even an MCP server for AI code editors, giving AI-native developers a real SDK/API surface to build against. However, evidence lacks explicit language-specific SDK libraries (e.g., Python/Node client packages) and OpenAPI spec discovery failed (404s), leaving some doubt about full programmatic tooling maturity. missing for 10: explicit official client SDK libraries in multiple languages, publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer corroboration of SDK quality.
